{{Top|leg}}
A '''circuit scanner''' was a device for inspecting the circuits of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] components. It consisted of a small booth with a podium on which the component was placed. A [[scanner hood]] containing a miniature [[vis pickup]] was lowered to allow the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] to examine the component to search for power-line anomalies.
